supported: XRP Insights and XRP Desk report materially different labeled exchange-wallet totals because their venue/wallet coverage and timestamps differ; neither total is tradable float.
The six US single-asset spot XRP ETFs are XRP, XRPZ, XRPC, GXRP, TOXR and XRPR; BITW is a separate multi-asset index sleeve.
ETF trackers do not agree on Nov 6 completeness or flow: one excludes GXRP from flows, one reports zero with no fund-level holdings, and one marks the day partial awaiting Franklin.
competing_hypotheses: A same-wallet decline at some exchanges could reflect withdrawals to self-custody, inter-exchange transfers or wallet relabeling rather than net market supply removal.
ETF holdings changes may approximate creations/redemptions but can also reflect fees, custody movements, data gaps or delayed issuer updates.
missing_or_disconfirming: No complete daily authorized-participant creation/redemption series has been reconciled across all six issuers.
No issuer-level raw holdings capture has yet been executed by the scheduled pipeline for the new Franklin, Canary and 21Shares endpoints.
The issuer page vintages observed are stale; none is admitted as current holdings.
